Article 8.3: BOGO Account Rules

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
Overview

A free BOGO account earned through a qualifying promotion must be redeemed within 45 calendar days of the qualifying purchase. If the free BOGO account is not redeemed within that 45-day period, the offer expires and the free account is forfeited.

Once redeemed, a free BOGO account is only valid while you also hold a qualifying account that is actively tradeable. A qualifying account is either a paid account or an active, tradeable funded account of any kind.

If your free BOGO account becomes the only qualifying account you have remaining, it may be automatically deleted under the rules below.

Activating Your Free BOGO Account

You activate your free BOGO account from your FFN dashboard.

Your free account appears in your dashboard once your qualifying purchase is complete, in the same account type and size you purchased.
Activate it within the 45-day redemption period.
You need an active paid account (or an active, tradeable Sim Funded account) when you activate it.
During a BOGO promotion, each purchased Standard MAX or FFN Perps evaluation earns one free BOGO account. STEADY purchases do not earn a free account. Free BOGO accounts already earned stay redeemable. Only one free BOGO account can be open at a time. A free FFN Perps account arrives at purchase, so there is nothing to activate, and it does not count toward the one free account open at a time.
45-Day Redemption Period

All free BOGO accounts must be redeemed within 45 calendar days of the original qualifying purchase.

The 45-day period begins on the date of the qualifying purchase.
The free BOGO account must be redeemed before the 45-day period expires.
Any BOGO offer that has not been redeemed within 45 days automatically expires and is forfeited.
Expired BOGO accounts or offers cannot be redeemed at a later date.
An expired BOGO has no cash value and cannot be transferred, exchanged, credited toward another purchase, or reinstated.
Redeeming a BOGO account does not remove any of the account requirements or dependency rules outlined below.

IMPORTANT: The 45-day redemption period is separate from the 3-day BOGO account check and the standard 29-day account inactivity rule.

The Rule

If you have only a free BOGO account and no active paid account or active, tradeable sim funded account, your free BOGO account is deleted.

This check runs every 3 days.
The free BOGO account is not eligible to stand on its own. It must be paired with a qualifying account.
An active, tradeable sim funded account of any kind counts the same as a paid account. This means you can hold a funded account plus a free BOGO account, and the free BOGO account will not be deleted. This rule is the same during a Promotion Review and while you hold an FFN Institution account.
You can identify a funded account by its account number, which begins with 2DF, EPS, EPV, or 7PV.

WARNING: At no point can you have two free BOGO accounts at the same time.

If you have an existing free BOGO account, you must remain eligible to redeem any future BOGO offer under these rules. Receiving another promotional offer does not extend, pause, or restart the original 45-day redemption period.

NOTE: The BOGO dependency check is separate from the standard 29-day account inactivity rule. The dependency check runs on its own 3-day cycle and specifically applies to free BOGO accounts that are left without an active paid or qualifying funded account.

BOGO and Promotions During a Promotion Review or in the FFN Institution

BOGO, discount codes and other promotions apply to evaluations during a Promotion Review and while you hold an FFN Institution account. Your free BOGO account is an evaluation and stays open. The BOGO rules in this article apply.

How to Keep Your BOGO Account

First, your BOGO offer must be redeemed within 45 calendar days of the qualifying purchase.

After redemption, maintain at least one qualifying paid or funded account alongside your free BOGO account.

If your paid account is cancelled, blown and not reset within the applicable 29-day period, becomes inactive, or otherwise stops qualifying, and you are left with only the free BOGO account, the BOGO account will be removed on the next 3-day check.

Redeeming the BOGO within 45 days does not guarantee that the account will remain active if you later fail to meet the account requirements outlined above.

Quick Reference
Situation	Result
BOGO offer redeemed within 45 days	BOGO may be activated, subject to all other BOGO rules
BOGO offer not redeemed within 45 days	BOGO expires and is forfeited
Free BOGO + actively traded paid account	BOGO account kept
Free BOGO + active, tradeable funded account (2DF / EPS / EPV / 7PV)	BOGO account kept
Free BOGO only, with no active paid or qualifying funded account	BOGO account deleted
Free BOGO + paid account that is blown/inactive	BOGO account deleted
Promotion Review or FFN Institution + active paid account	BOGO account kept
BOGO earned or activated during a Promotion Review or in the FFN Institution	Same BOGO rules
Two free BOGO accounts at the same time	Not permitted
Frequently Asked Questions

How do I activate my free BOGO account?
From your FFN dashboard, within 45 calendar days of the qualifying purchase. You need an active paid account (or an active, tradeable Sim Funded account) when you activate it. Only one free BOGO account can be open at a time.

How long do I have to redeem my free BOGO account?
You have 45 calendar days from the date of the qualifying purchase to redeem the free BOGO account.

What happens if I do not redeem my BOGO within 45 days?
The BOGO offer expires and the free account is forfeited. It cannot be redeemed later, reinstated, transferred, exchanged for cash, or applied as a credit toward another purchase.

Does buying another account restart my 45-day BOGO redemption period?
No. The 45-day redemption period is tied to the original qualifying purchase and does not restart or extend because another account is purchased.

Is the 45-day rule the same as the 3-day BOGO check?
No. They are separate rules. The 45-day rule determines how long you have to redeem your promotional BOGO account. Once the BOGO is redeemed, the 3-day dependency check determines whether you continue to meet the requirements to keep the free account.

How often is the BOGO account check run?
Every 3 days.

Does a funded account let me keep my free BOGO account?
Yes. An active, tradeable funded account of any kind counts the same as a paid account. A qualifying funded account plus a free BOGO account keeps the BOGO account from being deleted. A Promotion Review or an FFN Institution account does not change this.

How do I know if an account is a funded account?
A qualifying funded account's number begins with 2DF, EPS, EPV, or 7PV.

Can I use BOGO and other promotions during a Promotion Review or while I hold an FFN Institution account?
Yes. BOGO, discount codes and other promotions apply to evaluations at any time, and the usual BOGO rules apply.

Why was my free account deleted?
If your only remaining account was a free BOGO account with no active paid account or active, tradeable qualifying funded account, it may have been removed during the 3-day check. If the BOGO offer was never redeemed and more than 45 days have passed since the qualifying purchase, the BOGO offer has expired and is no longer valid.

Can I keep just the free BOGO account by itself?
No. A free BOGO account must be paired with a qualifying paid account or an active, tradeable qualifying funded account.

Can I have two free BOGO accounts at once?
No. At no point can you have two free BOGO accounts at the same time.
